note:
Henry Wing, magistrate for Nottingham and solicitor, a widower of 60, with his daughter, his married granddaughter and her infant son, his sister-in-law and two servants at 12 Park Terrace (#252) on the 1891 return, transcribed by A. Hagues. None of the seven was in the record, and 12 Park Terrace held **no census record at all** before this.

Wright's Directory prints 'Henry Wing, Esq, J.P., solicitor' at 12 Park Terrace in 1894-95 and 1898-99 - the census description exactly - so he held the house for at least eight years after this return. By 1910-11 it belongs to Charles E. Townroe, who is still there in 1915-16.

**A lead on four people already in the record, unfiled.** The record holds William Wing (#668, born 1864, solicitor), Sara Whitehead Wing (#669), Henry Wing (#670, born 1890) and Richard Wing (#671) with 1911 censuses and **no property**. Wright's prints 'Kentmere, Wing William, solicitor (H. Wing & Son)' on Cavendish Crescent North in 1910-11 and 1913-14, 'Kentmere, Wing Henry' in 1913-14, and 'Kentmere, Wing Mrs. Sarah W' in 1915-16. The firm name H. Wing & Son points back to this Henry, and the household names match the unfiled four closely. That unfiled 1911 household looks as though it belongs at Kentmere, Cavendish Crescent North - but placing it is a separate decision on separate evidence, so nothing here is moved or joined, and none of the four is bound.

**Relationships that the importer cannot carry are left in this note instead.** Constance Thomley is the head's granddaughter and Leslie Thomley his great-grandson; Sarah Ann Morris is his sister-in-law. Only the plain parent and child link is entered - Leslie to Constance, and Frances Mary Wing to her father - so the rest is recorded here rather than guessed into a shape the record does not hold. Constance is returned as married with her husband absent from the schedule. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1891 census, 12 Park Terrace, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1894-95, page 107 (Leicester Special Collections id 164613); 1898-99, page 115 (id 165291).
